_说明: viewer3d.html?model=elite_academy 的清单（标准档 elite_academy.glb + 低档 elite_academy_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。由 blender/landmarks/elite_academy/build.py（共用 blender/landmarks/upper_estates.py）+ blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。卡「贵族子弟接受私人教育或进入精英学院」，课程含家族管理、以太魔法修习、政治学、资产经营、礼仪与社交、军事基础；卡说教会进不了悬浮岛，不画礼拜堂。，详见 docs/card-buildings.md。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 灰石三层的四合院主楼，南面正中一座门楼塔，四角各一座楼梯塔，院心十字石径分开四块草坪——牛津式方院的样子。
desc.en: A three-storey grey-stone quadrangle with a gatehouse tower centred on the south range and a stair turret at each corner; a stone-paved cross divides the courtyard lawn into four plots, in an Oxford-quad manner.

desc.zh: 四合院与礼仪大厅、图书馆各自的铅皮四坡顶，屋脊立着成排砖石烟囱。
desc.en: Lead hipped roofs over the quad, the ceremonial hall and the library, with ranks of brick-and-stone chimneys along the ridges.

desc.zh: 四合院东侧的独立厅堂，高窗、铅皮顶、屋脊一座小灯亭，玻璃连廊接回主楼——礼仪与社交课在这里上。
desc.en: A freestanding hall east of the quad with tall windows, a lead roof and a small ridge lantern, linked back to the main range by a glazed gallery — where etiquette and social courses are held.

desc.zh: 四合院西侧一座缩小版的圆顶阅览室，环绕一圈玻璃窗，铅皮穹顶。
desc.en: A smaller domed reading room west of the quad, ringed with glazed windows under a lead dome.

desc.zh: 四合院北侧一圈同心铺地环，四根矮灯柱围出中性铺地——以太魔法修习课在这里练习，不带任何符号或文字。
desc.en: Concentric paved rings north of the quad, ringed by four low lamp posts on plain paving — where aether-craft practice is held, with no symbols or text.

desc.zh: 四合院南侧一片砾石操练场，接一块缩小的跑道式草场——军事基础课与体育课用地。
desc.en: A gravel drill yard south of the quad, adjoining a scaled-down running track and turf — used for military-basics and sports classes.

desc.zh: 岛边一圈橡树与雪松，挡住院墙外的视线。
desc.en: A ring of oaks and cedars along the island's edge, screening the grounds from outside.

desc.zh: 岛缘一座钢结构停靠平台，只供私人悬浮载具起降；卡说岛间只有私人悬浮载具，不画飞艇。
desc.en: A steel docking platform at the island's edge for private hover vehicles only; the card mentions only private hover transport between isles, so no airships are shown.

desc.zh: 岛缘符文环、悬浮玻璃亭与全息园灯——2088 魔导科技层的统一点缀，无文字、无徽记。
desc.en: A rune ring at the island's edge, floating glass pavilions and holographic garden lamps — the shared 2088 magitech dressing, with no text or crests.
